title: MailRoom — Export Selected
objective: Opening someone else's message is refused. Find another way to get the content of messages that aren't yours.

verifier.condition: The batch export endpoint returns the content of at least one message owned by a different user than the signed-in one.

weakness: The single-item endpoint enforces ownership, but the bulk endpoint that fetches many items by id applies no per-item ownership check.
seededData: Users alice (messages 1-3) and bob (messages 4-6) with short synthetic message bodies. In-memory.

credentials.label: Mail user
credentials.note: Try opening a message with another user's id first.

hints: The single-message endpoint is well protected. Does the inbox page need any other API to do its job?
Think about what an 'Export selected' feature sends to the server.
burpNotes: Use every feature of the inbox page with Burp running, and look at the request each one sends.
